senses.gloss: वाद- + अनुवाद वाद- + अनुवाद, m. 1. attack and rejoinder. 2. plaint and reply.
वदन- + इन्दु वदन- + इन्दु, m. a moon-like face, Śiś. 9, 30.
वाद- + चञ्चु वाद- + चञ्चु, m. a jester, Bhartṛ. 3, 57 (read राद- instead of वादि, and probably चुञ्चवः instead of चञ्चवः, cf. Pāṇ. 5, 2, 26; cf. Schol.).

वद् वद्, i. 1, Par. Ātm.
 1. To speak, to address (with the acc. of the object and the addressed person), MBh. 3, 1853.
 2. To speak of (with gen.), Pañc. 67, 22.
 3. To sound, to yell, MBh. 3, 15669.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. उदित,
 1. Pronounced, Cāṇ. 1 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 407.
 2. Addressed, Śiś. 9, 61.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the fut. pass. ब्रह्मोद्य, i. e. ब्रह्मन्-उद्य, n. Reciting or explaining the Veda; मृषोद्य, see s. v. सुखोद्य, i. e. सुख-उद्य, adj. To be uttered agreeably, Man. 2, 33.
 --Caus. वादय, To cause to sound, Pañc. 229, 13; to play, Man. 4, 64.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the pf. pass. जल-वादित, n. Water music, music performed by water, Hariv. 8426.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. वाद्य, n.
 1. Sound, Ragh. 16, 64.
 2. Any musical instrument, Pañc. 129, 15; Daśak. in Chr. 180, 7 (instrumental music).
 --Comp.
 जल-, n. a musical instrument sounded by means of water, Hariv. 8427.
 पर्ण-, n. a musical instrument made of leaves, Hariv. 3477.
 --† i. 10, Par. Ātm.
 1. To speak.
 2. To command.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, To speak similarly, to imitate another's voice or sound, Ragh. 5, 74 (Calc.).
 --With अप अप, To reprove, to insult, Man. 4, 236.
 --Caus. To dissuade from, to reprove, MBh. 3, 1036.
 --With अभि अभि,
 1. To address, Man. 8, 356.
 2. To salute respectfully, MBh. 3, 15668.
 --Caus.
 1. To greet respectfully, [] Man. 2, 117; Vikr. 81, 2; with पादयोस्, To greet one by touching his feet, Man. 2, 212.
 2. To play, MBh. 3, 14386.
 --With प्रत्यभि प्रति-अभि, Caus. To return a salute, Mṛcch. 34, 7.
 --With आ आ, To salute by roaring, Chr. 290, 9 = Rigv. i. 64, 9.
 --With समा सम्-आ, To speak, MBh. 3, 16148.
 --With उप उप, Ātm.
 1. To conciliate, Bhaṭṭ. 8, 28.
 2. To beg, Pañc. in Weber, Ind. St. 272, 22 (see my transl. n. 922).
 3. To allure.
 --With परि परि, To calumniate, MBh. 1, 3079.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To converse, Pañc. 143, 21.
 2. To explain, Man. 5, 55.
 3. To declare, Hit. ii. d. 160.
 4. To call, Hit. ii. d. 41.
 5. To tell, MBh. 3, 2910.
 --Caus. To play, MBh. 1, 5356.
 --With विप्र वि-प्र, To disagree.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, Par. To accord. Ātm. To converse, Bhaṭṭ. 8, 28.
 --With प्रति प्रति, To answer, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 13.
 --With वि वि, Ātm. (also Par., Hit. iii. d. 32; Pañc. 183, 6).
 1. To dispute, to wrangle, Man. 3, 159.
 2. To contest, with acc., MBh. 2, 2390.
 --With सम् सम्, To converse, Chr. 19, 8; Hit. 88, 13; iii. d. 36.
 --Caus.
 1. To play, MBh. 1, 7056.
 2. To declare, Man. 8, 31.
 --With विसम् वि-सम्, To break a promise, Man. 8, 219.
 --Cf. αὐδή, αὐδάω, perhaps ϕράζω, ϕραδάω; probably Lat. vas, vadis; perhaps O.H.G. far-wâzan; O. Saxon, for-wâtan, recusare.

वद वद् + अ, adj. Speaking, speaking well.
 --Cf. वशंवद.

वाद वाद, i. e. वद् + अ, m.
 1. Speaking, Daśak. in Chr. 198, 11.
 2. Sound, Pañc. 248, 11; words, i. d. 475.
 3. Discussion, controversy, Man. 12, 46.
 4. Exposition of holy texts, Man. 6, 50.
 5. Demonstrated conclusion, result.
 6. Accusation.
 7. Report, Daśak. in Chr. 191, 19.
 --Comp.

वदन वद् + अन, n. The mouth, the face, Pañc. 185, 25.
 --Comp.
वादन वादन, i. e. वद्, Caus., + अन, n. Instrumental music, Man. 2, 178.

वदान्य वदान्य, adj.
 I. i. e. अव-दान + य (also वदन्य वदन्य), Munificent, liberal, Man. 4, 224.
 II. (from वद्),
 1. Speaking kindly.
 2. Eloquent.
वदरी वदरी, f. see बदर, Matsyop. 3, and MBh. 3, 1637; questionable, probably = बदरी-शैल, n. A part of the Himālayarange, and a celebrated place of pilgrimage, cf. Johns. Sel. 90, n.
वदाल वदाल, m. A sheat-fish, Silurus boalis Ham.
वदावद वदावद (an old frequent. of वद् + अ), adj. Speaking, able to speak well.

वादक वादक, i. e. वद्, Caus., + अक, adj. sbst.
 1. A musician, Johns. Sel. 52, 116.
 2. A speaker.
 --Comp.

वादि वादि (vb. वद्), adj.
 1. Speaking.
 2. Wise.

वादित्र वादित्र, i. e. वद्, Caus., + त्र, n.
 1. A musical instrument, Man. 4, 64.
 2. Instrumental music, Indr. 3, 9.
ऽवादित्व -वादित्व, i. e. वादिन् + त्व, n. in सत्य-, Veracity, Hit. i. d. 98, M.M.

वादिन् वादिन्, i. e. वद् + इन्,
 I. adj.
 1. Speaking, Vikr. d. 118; Johns. Sel. 57, 164; a speaker, Bhartṛ. 3, 53.
 2. Asserting.
 3. Disputing, Bhartṛ. 3, 47.
 II. m.
 1. An expounder of the law.
 2. A plaintiff, Lass. 92, 2.
 3. Key-note.
 --Comp.
